aspects.says: A missing property, a misspelt name and an unresolved ${...} all count as absent: a @Config field keeps its initialiser and get returns an empty string, so a value with no safe default must have none.
basis: section:14.2 A Value Nobody Set Is Absent, and Absent Means the Default

aspects.says: An attr element is set through the MBean server, so the setter must be in the bean's MBean interface or the file is .BAD, and a value changed over JMX lasts until the next redeploy.
basis: section:14.4 `<attr>` Is Set Through JMX, So Its Setter Belongs in the MBean Interface

aspects.says: Within one pass every init comes before every start, so a QBean looks for another in startService, fails the start when it is missing, and looks it up again at each use.
basis: section:14.5 Nothing Is Started Until Everything Is Initialised, So a QBean Looks for What It Needs in `startService`

aspects.says: Q2 reads a new file as soon as it appears, so a descriptor written in place can be renamed .BAD half-written; write it elsewhere and move it in.
basis: section:14.6 Q2 Deploys Whatever It Finds in `deploy/`, Even Half a File

aspects.says: After a pass, each descriptor's file name and its QBean's state in JMX show what Q2 did with it.
basis: section:14.1 A Deploy Directory You Can Inspect
aspects.reason: the tool the lesson's examples and the practices' tests use, not a skill to practise on its own

aspects.says: A ConfigurationException from setConfiguration renames the descriptor .BAD and leaves no bean registered, while a refusal in initService leaves the file in place and the bean Unknown.
basis: section:14.3 A Configuration Refused in `setConfiguration` Renames the File; Refused Later, It Only Logs

aspects.says: deployElement with isTransient adds the Q2 instance id, and a later Q2 deletes a descriptor whose id is not its own.
basis: section:14.6 Q2 Deploys Whatever It Finds in `deploy/`, Even Half a File
aspects.reason: the leftover case needs a JVM that dies before it deletes the file; the lesson shows the run, and a graded test could only retype the instance id check

aspects.says: A bean whose init threw is Unknown and start does nothing for it, while a bean whose start threw is Failed and can be started again.
basis: section:14.3 A Configuration Refused in `setConfiguration` Renames the File; Refused Later, It Only Logs

aspects.says: Starts run one after another on Q2's thread in file order, so a wait in startService can't let a provider in a later file start, and it delays every start after it.
basis: section:14.5 Nothing Is Started Until Everything Is Initialised, So a QBean Looks for What It Needs in `startService`
